what_happened: In wet freeway traffic, the ego slowed to about 4 m/s and drifted left onto the line between its lane and the lane to its left. Meanwhile the recorded human path, and the RIGHT command, went toward the right. Vehicle 41 was coming up alongside in the left lane, and the ego's front-left clipped it.

The route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT, and the recorded path bore right. Instead, the policy steered left across the lane line into the adjacent lane, accelerating to about 6 m/s, and cut in just ahead of the traffic there (actors 96 and 56 behind it, 37 ahead). This caused a lateral collision, with the trailing car also hitting the ego's rear.

After handoff the ego braked hard on an open highway lane (16.8 to 8.4 m/s while the gap to the lead grew) and drifted left about 1.1 m off the recorded path, toward the lane line. Actor 1, a replayed car in the left lane, kept its recorded speed, came up alongside, and made side contact with the ego's left side.

Log-replayed vehicle 16 starts overlapping the ego's rear at 2.7s, passes through the ego's body at 3.7s, and comes out just ahead of it. At 4.7s, the exact moment the policy takes over, the ego's front still overlaps 16's rear, so a front collision is recorded before the policy could do anything. Until then the ego was on the recorded human path (0.0 m off) at about 14 m/s.

The route said RIGHT and the recorded human path curved right. Instead, the policy steered the ego left across the lane line and sped up from about 4.6 to 6.1 m/s. At 7.3 s it cut into the adjacent lane in front of actor 56, which was close behind on the left, and the two collided (side contact, and 56 also struck the ego's rear).

On a multi-lane highway the route command changed to RIGHT, but the ego planned and steered left, away from the recorded path, which stayed in its lane and bent right. It sped up from about 4.6 to 6.3 m/s and cut into the left lane at 7.3 s, side-swiping vehicle 56, which was alongside and slightly behind in that lane (lateral collision; rear contact was also recorded).

This is a scenario artifact, not a policy error. Actor 16 overlaps the ego from the first frame: behind it at 2.7 s (rear contact flagged at that frame), on top of it at 3.7 s, and just ahead of it at 4.7 s. A front collision is recorded at 4.7 s, the same moment the policy takes over. The ego was still replaying the recorded drive (0 m off the recording), so the policy never controlled the car before the contact. Actor 16 looks like a duplicate or ghost track of the ego, and it shows as a smeared blob in the camera at 3.7 s and 4.7 s.

Actor 16 is a replayed vehicle that doesn't react to the ego. Before handoff it came up from behind, overlapped the ego (rear collision flagged at 2.7s and 3.7s) and drove straight through it. At 4.7s, the instant the policy took over, it was just ahead with its rear still touching the ego's front, so a front collision was logged with no time for the policy to respond.

After handoff on a multi-lane highway, the ego braked hard for no clear reason (16.8 to 7.8 m/s while the gap to the lead car was growing) and its planned path drifted left onto the lane line. By 6.6 s it was about 1.2 m left of the human's recorded path, and actor 1, coming up in the left lane, sideswiped its left side. Actor 1 stayed in its own lane, so the ego's leftward drift caused the contact.

On the highway, the ego braked hard for no clear reason, slowing from 16.8 to 8.3 m/s even though the lead car (18) was pulling away. At the same time it drifted left across the lane line, while the recorded human path went right. Its left side hit actor 1, which was coming up in the adjacent left lane.

The route command was RIGHT, but at about 3.4 m/s the ego drifted left, away from its planned path, toward the adjacent left lane. Actor 41, a white pickup, came up on the left and passed the ego. At 8.6 s the ego's front hit 41's rear corner as the ego moved into that lane.

The command was RIGHT and the recorded path stayed in the lane, but the policy steered left across lanes on the highway at about 7 m/s. It ended up 4.9 m off the recorded path and side-swiped vehicle 28, which was travelling in the lane to its left.

The ego was moving slowly (about 3.3 m/s) on a wet multi-lane highway with a RIGHT command, but its planned path swung left into the adjacent lane just as pickup 41 came past on the left. The ego's front ran into the side or rear of pickup 41, which is the white truck filling the left of the camera view at 8.5s.

On a wet multi-lane highway, the policy slowed to about 3 m/s and stayed in its lane, drifting slightly left. In the recording, the human moved right to follow the RIGHT command and was about 7 m further ahead. Actor 41, a white pickup replayed from the log, came up from behind on the left and moved into the lane the human had left. It cut in at the ego's front-left corner, which the metrics count as a front collision.

The command was RIGHT and the recorded human path went right, but the policy steered left across the lane line. Its front corner hit vehicle 28, which was travelling in the left lane alongside it; at the moment of contact the ego was 5 m off the recorded path.

On a multi-lane freeway with a RIGHT command, the policy steered left away from the recorded path, drifting about 5 m off it across lanes. At about 6.5 m/s its front hit vehicle 28, which was traveling in the adjacent left lane.

The route command was RIGHT, but after handoff the ego drifted left out of its highway lane, away from the recorded path. At about 6.5 m/s it ran its front into vehicle 28, which was travelling alongside in the lane to the left.

Ego was in slow highway traffic at about 3 m/s with the route command switching to RIGHT. Instead of following its planned path to the right, it drifted left toward the lane line and hit actor 41 as that car came up alongside in the left lane. The lead truck stayed 15–21 m ahead, and the camera smear at impact only appears at the collision itself.
